summary: Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-E (880 lines; 31 PDF pages). Checked all 28 estimates against text extracted directly with PyMuPDF from every page cited in their sources (PDF pp. 6, 8, 13, 14, 15, and 28), and checked supporting design, measurement, and sample information on PDF pp. 5, 7, 9, 12, 20, and 26. All recorded statistics and analyzed arm counts match the PDF and belong to the recorded outcomes and arms. Table 1 dispersion intervals are arm-level intervals, not contrast intervals; control intervals are retained in notes. Table 2 coverage and match columns are correctly distinguished from paste telemetry. The Holm-adjusted counterclaim and PC1 p-values and AI-text-coverage p-value and negative d are correctly attributed. No unsupported totals or figure-derived values were recorded. The three supplied text_features warnings are false positives: creativity-codebook.md section 6 explicitly includes text_features, added October 11, 2026, and extraction-spec.md also lists it. The normalized content-word counts described on PDF p. 9 and in Figure 7 on p. 28 fit this category. No measure recoding is needed for those three records. Checked question, construct, measure, unit, higher_is, AI availability, timing, within-person status, comparison type, and uncertainty basis. The retained comparisons use the three randomized Phase 1 arms; the separately recruited Time-Matched Unlock cohort and AI-only corpus are excluded from estimates. The passage-evaluation task, process measures, and self-reports are appropriately excluded. No additional in-scope outcome or reported full-sample contrast was found.
